Qualcomm (QCOM) Shareholder Gofen & Glossberg Decreased Its Holding by $487,616; Msdc Management LP Raised Its Holding in Coty (COTY) as Share Price Declined
May 17, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Msdc Management Lp increased its stake in Coty Inc (COTY) by 21.07% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Msdc Management Lp bought 1.24M shares as the company’s stock declined 8.23% with the market. The hedge fund held 7.14M shares of the package goods and cosmetics company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $142.09 million, up from 5.90 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Msdc Management Lp who had been investing in Coty Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $10.62 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.48% or $0.36 during the last trading session, reaching $14.15. About 3.91 million shares traded. Coty Inc. (NYSE:COTY) has risen 0.16% since May 17, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 11.39% the S&P500.
Gofen & Glossberg Llc decreased its stake in Qualcomm (QCOM) by 3.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Gofen & Glossberg Llc sold 7,619 shares as the company’s stock declined 15.28% with the market. The institutional investor held 218,715 shares of the radio and television broadcasting and communications equipment company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $14.00 million, down from 226,334 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Gofen & Glossberg Llc who had been investing in Qualcomm for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $84.09B market cap company. The stock increased 0.03% or $0.015 during the last trading session, reaching $56.715. About 6.65 million shares traded. QUALCOMM Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) has declined 3.21% since May 17, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 14.76% the S&P500.
